title: dendranthema zawadzkii subsp. peleiolepis
intro: Dendranthema zawadzkii subsp. peleiolepis, commonly known as Chrysanthemum zawadzkii, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Asia, traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions such as fever, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum zawadzkii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies.
